The change (a) adds a Gomrey-owned slide-animation catalog and deterministic stylesheet generator at servers/nextjs/lib/slide-animations/ adapted from the MIT-licensed donor 0xRafie/nextslide @ 90a46f933b3056d27460400c915ef268a9ec3f56, re-namespaced from the donor's animate-*/ns-* to gs-anim-*/gs-keyframe-*/--gs-ease-*; (b) adds 28 deterministic node:test assertions in servers/nextjs/tests/slide-animations.test.mjs; (c) adds docs/donors/nextslide-skill/{LICENSE,NOTICE.md,UPSTREAM_README.md} and a docs/SOURCE_LEDGER.md admission record; (d) adds a research record under research/rea/2026-10-22-nextslide-gamma/. The module performs no I/O, no network access, no filesystem access and no credential access. It is not yet wired into any rendering surface. Gates executed on this exact revision: root npm test 48/48, FastAPI pytest 1125 passed, Next.js node --test 101/101, Next.js eslint 0 errors, Next.js production build success, Electron typecheck/build/main-globals/path-migration pass, scan-secrets OK, check-fixtures OK, check-platform-support OK, validate-release-config OK, generate-release-manifest --check-only OK, presentation-export runtime 1.0.34 verified. The donor's wildcard selector [class*="animate-"] was deliberately NOT adopted because it matches Tailwind CSS v4 animate-spin/animate-pulse/animate-bounce/animate-ping utilities and would blank product spinners to opacity:0; the donor's animate-counter-up has no @keyframes and was reclassified as engine:controller with hidesUntilStart false so it is never permanently hidden.
